definitions.explanation: A room designated for private use, as opposed to a shared or open space. Common in restaurants, hospitals, hotels, and other facilities.

examples.japanese: {個室|こしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{個室|こしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{入院|にゅういん}する→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧なら⟦{大部屋|おおべや}→大部屋：28441_oobeya⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{個室|こしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}く→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧。
examples.english: If I'm hospitalized, I'd feel more at ease in a private room than a shared ward.

notes:
In Japanese restaurants, {個室|こしつ} are popular for business dinners, dates, and group gatherings where privacy is desired. In hospitals, {個室|こしつ} typically cost more than shared wards (⟦{大部屋|おおべや}→大部屋：28441_oobeya⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個室|こしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧ (reserve a private room)
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{個室|こしつ} (fully private room)
- {個室|こしつ}⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ (private room charge)
- {個室|こしつ}ダイニング (private dining room)
